boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct study environments documented by Randolph-Macon’s current academic catalog within McGraw-Page Library.

cards.title: Hardaway Abernathy Study Room
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • first floor
cards.notes: Use this room when you need a round-the-clock library setting; bring your materials and use the on-site printer, vending machines, and restrooms.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 study room with practical late-session amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Abernathy Room provides 24/7 student study space with a printer, vending machines, and restrooms.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Documented as 24/7 study space for students.

cards.entity_name: McGraw-Page Library First-Floor Reservable Study Rooms
cards.title: First-Floor Reservable Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • first floor
cards.notes: Reserve a study room for a group project or a focused session; confirm the current reservation process with the library before making plans.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for individual study and group projects.
cards.evidence_claim: McGraw-Page Library offers reservable study rooms among seating options for individual study and group projects.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; the catalog does not publish room-specific availability or reservation instructions.

cards.title: First-Floor Large Tables
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • first floor
cards.notes: Set up shared readings, notes, or a project spread at a large table, then use nearby circulation, printing, and reserves as needed.
cards.short_summary: A table-based option near core first-floor library services.
cards.evidence_claim: Large tables on the library’s first and second floors facilitate individual study and group projects; the first floor houses circulation, printing, and reserves.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog identifies the first floor as a service center; consult the library for current building access.

cards.title: First-Floor Booth-Style Seating
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • first floor
cards.notes: Choose booth-style seating for a contained work surface while staying close to the first-floor collections and research support services.
cards.short_summary: Booth seating within the library’s active service floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Booth-style seating on the library’s first and second floors is provided to facilitate individual study and group projects.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog does not publish booth availability; consult the library for current building access.

cards.title: First-Floor Computer Area
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • first floor
cards.notes: Use an available desktop when course software matters; ask at the Information Desk about short- or long-term laptop loans for work elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: Desktop access plus laptop-loan support for academic projects.
cards.evidence_claim: A limited number of desktop computers are available on the library’s first floor, and the Information Desk lends laptops for short- and long-term loans.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Desktop quantity is limited; laptop loans are handled at the Information Desk.

cards.title: Makerspace
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • first floor
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from making or prototyping, and check with Instructional Design & Technology for equipment support or training.
cards.short_summary: A project-work setting with fabrication and virtual-reality tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The first-floor Makerspace includes 3D printers, virtual reality, a laser cutter, Legos, and equipment support for academic assignments.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Equipment support is provided by Instructional Design & Technology; confirm tool availability or training needs before visiting.

cards.entity_name: McGraw-Page Library Second-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Second-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • second floor
cards.notes: Head upstairs for a designated quiet setting, then pull a print book or settle into a focused reading and writing session.
cards.short_summary: The library’s full second floor is designated for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s second floor contains its print-book collection and the entire floor is designated as a quiet study area.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Consult the library for current building access.

cards.entity_name: McGraw-Page Library Second-Floor Individual Study Carrels
cards.title: Second-Floor Individual Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • second floor
cards.notes: Choose an individual carrel for a self-contained reading or drafting block, using the quiet-floor designation to keep the session focused.
cards.short_summary: Individual workstations within the designated quiet-study floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Individual study carrels on the library’s first and second floors facilitate individual study and group projects; the second floor is designated as a quiet study area.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog does not publish carrel availability; consult the library for current building access.

cards.title: J. Rives Childs Room
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • second floor
cards.notes: Plan an evening or weekend work session here; during the day the room is assigned to library instruction and staff meetings.
cards.short_summary: A named room that shifts to student study use outside daytime programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The J. Rives Childs Room is available evenings and weekends as a student study space; during the day it serves library instruction and staff meetings.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Available for student study evenings and weekends; daytime use is reserved for library instruction and staff meetings.

cards.title: Special Collections and Archives
cards.subtitle: McGraw-Page Library • second floor
cards.notes: Build a primary-source research session around the College Archives or the Virginia Methodism, Casanova, and Henry Miller collections; arrange access as needed.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor archival setting for collection-based research.
cards.evidence_claim: Special Collections and Archives is located on McGraw-Page Library’s second floor and houses the College Archives and collections including Virginia Methodism, Casanova, and Henry Miller.
cards.source_title: McGraw-Page Library | Randolph-Macon College Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: The catalog identifies the location and collections but does not publish visitor access procedures; contact the library before a collection visit.
